name: The Ashwick Ferry — Boathouse (Original Placeholder)
ambient: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER AREA) A low boathouse that smells of tar, wet rope and old grain. A brick tack room has been sealed behind a single locked door.

doors.name: Tack-Room Door
doors.description: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER DOOR) A narrow door reinforced with a cross-brace. The lock is newer than the wood, and the keyhole is bright with use.

objects.name: Ferryman's Ledger
objects.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER OBJECT) A ledger lies open on the desk, its pages swollen with damp. Most of the last entry has been blotted out.

interactions.label: Search the desk and read the ledger
interactions.success_text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER CLUE) Under the blotter you find the last page intact. The noon crossing is entered and struck through. Below it, in Ivo's hand: "One fare after the bell. The token is with the drowned. Do not ring without it."
interactions.failure_text: The damp has glued the pages together. You cannot make out the last entry yet.

success_effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The ledger places Ivo on the water after the last lawful crossing. The bell was not rung for a passenger.

objects.name: Nail Behind the Desk
objects.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER OBJECT) A bent nail behind the desk, half hidden by a hanging coil of rope. Something metal catches the light.

interactions.label: Search behind the desk
interactions.success_text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) A spare tack-room key hangs from a tarred cord. The tag is blank, but the cut matches the bright lock.
interactions.failure_text: The rope and old netting are tangled together. You cannot reach the nail.

success_effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The spare key is yours. Maela need not give up hers.

objects.name: Boathouse Steps
objects.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER OBJECT) Wet steps lead back down to the moored skiff. The landing light is a small yellow smudge across the water.

interactions.label: Row back to the landing
interactions.success_text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) You push off and row back through the fog.

objects.name: Ferryman's Strongbox
objects.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER OBJECT) A small iron strongbox is wedged behind the desk, its lid scuffed by repeated use. The lock is newer than the box.

interactions.label: Pick the strongbox lock
interactions.success_text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The lock gives. Inside is a folded toll receipt and a page torn from the ledger.
interactions.failure_text: The lock is stiff with river damp. You can try again, but the box has not opened.

success_effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The receipt names one passage paid in silver, the bell to be rung twice, and a note in Ivo's hand: "Maela's draught. One more fare and the debt is done. The second ring will keep them on the far bank."

effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER ENCOUNTER) The tack room stinks of river mud. Two drowned shapes unfold from the harness racks, still wearing ferrymen's coats.

entry_effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The boathouse is empty. A locked tack room waits at the north wall, and the desk has been left as if someone meant to return.
